task: Rewrite clearly: The box contains 23 sealed cartridges, not 25.
good: The box contains 23 sealed cartridges, not 25.

task: Rewrite: The rate rose from 12% to 16%, a rise of 4 percentage points, not a 4% relative rise.
invariants: Rise is 4 percentage points, not 4% relative.
good: The rate rose from 12% to 16%: 4 percentage points, not a 4% relative rise.
bad: The rate rose from 12% to 16%, a 4% relative rise.

task: Rewrite: The buyer may cancel before packing begins; cancellation is optional.
invariants: Buyer has permission, not a requirement, to cancel before packing.
good: The buyer can cancel before packing begins but does not have to.
bad: The buyer must cancel before packing begins.

task: Rewrite: Publish only after both the lawyer and director approve in writing.
invariants: Both lawyer and director must approve.
Approvals must be written and precede publication.
good: Publish only after receiving written approval from both the lawyer and director.
bad: Publish after the lawyer or director approves.

task: Explain: The observational report found an association between training and productivity. It does not establish causation.
invariants: Observational report finds association, not established causation.
good: The report links training with productivity but does not establish that training caused a change.
bad: The report proves training caused higher productivity.

task: Rewrite: Isolate the power and verify the circuit is de-energized before opening the cover.
invariants: Isolate power and verify de-energization before opening cover.
good: Before opening the cover, isolate the power and verify the circuit is de-energized.
bad: Open the cover, then isolate the power and check the circuit.

task: When will delivery arrive? Use only this note: The part has shipped, but the arrival date is unknown.
invariants: Arrival date is unknown; do not invent a deadline.
good: The part has shipped, but its arrival date is unknown.
bad: The shipped part will arrive by Tuesday.

task: Rewrite: The audit found no evidence of unencrypted records. This does not prove all records were encrypted.
invariants: No evidence of unencrypted records is not proof all records encrypted.
good: The audit found no evidence of unencrypted records, but it does not prove every record was encrypted.
bad: The audit proved that every record was encrypted.

task: Return this sentence verbatim, without commentary: We may pause service.
invariants: Exact requested sentence, with may not must, and no commentary.
